Next the user has asked me to delete an appointment but they haven't specified which one. Given that the email exchange was in regards to cancelling an appointment, I think it's safe to assume that this is the same appointment that the user wants to delete. There is an appointment scheduled for July 30 that fits the description so I'll remove that.
